name: @pp-namias/sanity-functions
description: Sanity Functions for the Namias CMS showcase (scheduled-publish, broken-refs, auto-tag-images).

scripts.deploy:scheduled-publish: cd scheduled-publish && npx sanity functions deploy scheduled-publish
scripts.deploy:broken-refs: cd broken-refs && npx sanity functions deploy broken-refs
scripts.deploy:auto-tag-images: cd auto-tag-images && npx sanity functions deploy auto-tag-images
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:scheduled-publish && npm run deploy:broken-refs && npm run deploy:auto-tag-images
